# Cart and checkout

Changes to the cart and progress through checkout, before an order exists.

[All domains](README.md)

## `add_to_cart_failed`

Adding to the cart failed, for example because the item went out of stock.

**Sources:** browser, server · **Version:** 1

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `product.id` | string | yes | max length 256 |
| `reason` | string | yes |  |

Other fields come from the `product`, `cart` block.

```json
{
  "product": {
    "id": "id_1"
  },
  "reason": "reason_1"
}
```
